_meta.DO_NOT_EXPOSE: Hidden content: the ideal stance per quarter reveals the future. Read only by readingScore.ts and act5End.ts (plus tests/ and tools/); never by selectors, the UI during play, or player-like bots.
_meta.stance: scarcity exposure: +1 adds exposure (a bet that firm ground power stays scarce and dear), -1 sells or hedges it, 0 logged for the reveal timeline only

low_exposure_quiet.why: Mine (as Act IV's M36.11 quiet_no_exposure): a quarter with no scored move while the exposure line (leases + free MW + plants) is under 15% of act5Entry counts as a match in every future, so an orbit- or cash-heavy company is not punished for a question that barely touches it (doc 43 §0.8).

rules.same_quarter_hedges: A build's own hedges and debt count 0 in its quarter (M40-41 rule, carried).
rules.raise: An equity raise takes the sign of the next scored move, at any distance; 0 if none follows before the act ends (M41).
rules.lease_offers: Lock-or-roll applies at each renewal or blend-and-extend offer: long (8-10 years) −1, short (2 years) +1; letting a lease run on its existing term logs nothing.

v1.why: Queue is King: add scarcity exposure throughout (short renewals, hold free MW, pay upgrades, keep plants merchant).

decoy.why: The SMR wave tempts selling scarcity (the Demand Plateau reading) just as the queue locks up.

v2.why: Flexible Lane: calm before the trigger (a 7% scarcity rise can't pay a bet); from 2038Q1 flexibility pays, so enrol load and take the fast lane (lease moves score 0 here).

decoy.why: The SMR wave tempts selling scarcity early, before the trigger, when V2 still pays for exposure.

v3.why: Demand Plateau: calm before the trigger; defensive from 2037Q4 (lock leases long, contract output, sell to funds).

decoy.why: A record auction tempts buying scarcity (the Queue is King reading) just before demand plateaus.

v4.why: Up and Out: calm while the ground holds; defensive from 2039 as orbit takes the marginal gigawatt.

decoy.why: The SMR wave tempts selling the ground early for the wrong reason; the softening comes in 2039, from orbit.
